STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_221002.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_221002.v · Open raw
module origen_221002(
    input RESET,
    input CLK,
    input N_TXE,
    input N_RXF,
    input CDONE,
    input [7:0] DATAOUT,
    output reg JTCK,
    output reg N_CONF,
    output reg N_CS,
    output reg N_CE,
    output reg ASDI,
    output reg N_RD,
    output reg WR,
    inout [7:0] d
);

reg [7:0] From_FT245;
reg [7:0] ft245_d;

reg [1:0] state;
parameter IDLE = 2'b00, RD_ACTIVE = 2'b01, WR_ACTIVE = 2'b10;

always @(posedge CLK or posedge RESET) begin
    if (RESET) begin
        state <= IDLE;
        JTCK <= 0;
        N_CONF <= 0;
        N_CS <= 0;
        N_CE <= 0;
        ASDI <= 0;
        N_RD <= 0;
        WR <= 0;
        From_FT245 <= 0;
        ft245_d <= 0;
    end else begin
        case (state)
            IDLE: begin
                if (~N_RXF) begin
                    state <= RD_ACTIVE;
                    N_RD <= 0;
                    WR <= 0;
                end else if (~N_TXE) begin
                    state <= WR_ACTIVE;
                    N_RD <= 0;
                    WR <= 0;
                end else begin
                    N_RD <= 1;
                    WR <= 1;
                end
            end
            RD_ACTIVE: begin
                if (~N_RXF) begin
                    From_FT245 <= DATAOUT;
                    N_RD <= 0;
                    WR <= 1;
                end else begin
                    state <= IDLE;
                    N_RD <= 1;
                    WR <= 1;
                end
            end
            WR_ACTIVE: begin
                if (~N_TXE) begin
                    ft245_d <= From_FT245;
                    N_RD <= 1;
                    WR <= 0;
                end else begin
                    state <= IDLE;
                    N_RD <= 1;
                    WR <= 1;
                end
            end
            default: begin
                state <= IDLE;
                N_RD <= 1;
                WR <= 1;
            end
        endcase

        // JTAG signal generation
        JTCK <= ~JTCK;
        N_CONF <= CDONE;
        N_CS <= 1;
        N_CE <= 1;
        ASDI <= From_FT245[0];
    end
end

assign d = ft245_d;

endmodule
